title: Create data models
goal: The model is built and written down so someone else could run it: its inputs, the rule it applies, its assumptions, and how far it was right on data it had not seen.

steps.do: Build the simplest thing that answers the question, a count, a rate or a ratio, and record it as the baseline every later model must beat.
Record the model's inputs, the rule it applies and every assumption it rests on, in enough detail that another person could compute the same answer by hand.
Hold back part of the data or a later window, run the model against it, and write how far off it was and where it was worst, against the baseline.
Attach the model, its baseline and its error to the handoff as evidence, and raise to the strategy lead whether it is good enough to act on.

done_criteria.check: Is the model written down well enough to be recomputed by hand, and was it measured on data it had not seen against a simple baseline?
